title: OTTO: candidate retrieval and ranking
research_question: Which candidate-generation and ranking decisions transfer when sessions, event types and inference cost differ?
validation_focus: Session/time boundaries, candidate recall versus final ranking quality, and prediction-ID alignment.
experiment_focus: Compare a fixed candidate generator with and without the proposed ranking stage; report recall and final metric separately.

title: BirdCLEF 2024: context and pseudo-label isolation
research_question: How should soundscape context, source quality and pseudo-label generation be adapted to a new audio dataset?
validation_focus: Recording/site overlap, held-out targets entering pseudo-label generation, and clip-to-soundscape metric alignment.
experiment_focus: Compare one fixed supervised baseline with one context or pseudo-label change on the same split and inference budget.

title: ROGII: domain alignment and reliability routing
research_question: When do alignment-grid and reliability-routing decisions transfer across wells with different domain conditions?
validation_focus: Well-level separation, inference-visible information, reliability strata and mismatch between CV and leaderboard.
experiment_focus: Compare one fixed baseline with one alignment or routing change on a well-separated split; report strata and aggregate error.

title: American Express: customer histories and entity splits
research_question: Which grouped-history feature families and shared-fold practices transfer to a new repeated-customer table?
validation_focus: Customer separation, fitted preprocessing boundaries, aligned OOF identities and official versus proxy metrics.
experiment_focus: Add one last/mean/variation feature family to a fixed baseline; preserve customer split IDs and evaluate the target metric.

title: M5: deployment horizon and forecasting ensembles
research_question: How do direct/recursive forecasting and ensemble choices transfer when the forecast horizon or hierarchy changes?
validation_focus: Deployment-length rolling windows, lag availability, recursive rollout and aggregation weights.
experiment_focus: Compare direct and recursive forecasts on fixed deployment-length windows at equal training cost; record window-level errors.
